*Biography of the Venerable Master Wú*

by [權德輿](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%AC%8A%E5%BE%B7%E8%BC%BF) (Quán Déyú, 761–818) — mid-Táng statesman

A Táng **biography of [吳筠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%B3%E7%AD%A0) Wú Yún** (*d.* 778), composed by the mid-Táng statesman Quán Déyú. Important primary source for Wú Yún's life. Preserved as **DZ 1053** / CT 1053 (Tài xuán bù 太玄部).

**Dating.** Within Quán Déyú's active lifetime. Dynasty: 唐.
